data.one_liner: Provides a static list of world languages with ISO‑639‑1 codes and optional localized names.
data.what_it_does: The package ships with a comprehensive collection of languages, their English names and ISO‑639‑1 codes. It can optionally load locale‑specific language names so apps can display language names in the device's language.
use_when: You need a ready‑made list of languages for a language selector or settings screen
You want to show language names in the user's locale without building your own translation files
avoid_when: You need full i18n support for app strings (use intl or slang)
You require dynamic updates or custom language data
strengths: Simple static API, no platform setup
Optional localized names loaded at runtime
weaknesses: Only provides language metadata, not full translation support
Localized names require an explicit initialization step
No code generation or advanced i18n features

alternatives.name: flutter_localized_locales
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides locale‑aware language names and integrates with intl for broader i18n

alternatives.name: intl
alternatives.why_pick_it: Full i18n solution with date/number formatting and message translation

alternatives.name: slang
alternatives.why_pick_it: Code‑generated localization with strong type safety
